## Summary

What does this PR change, and why? Keep it short — link issues for context.

Fixes #\<issue-number\>

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (existing behavior changes)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Build / CI

## How Has This Been Tested?

- [ ] `pytest backend/tests/` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build` passes in `frontend/`
- [ ] Manual testing (describe what you tried)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] My code follows the project's style (Python 4-space, TS/Vue 2-space)
- [ ] I have added/updated tests where it makes sense
- [ ] I have updated relevant docs (README / CHANGELOG / docstrings)
- [ ] No new secrets, debug logs, or commented-out code
- [ ] No unrelated changes (drive-by refactors in a separate PR please)

## Screenshots / Recordings

UI changes only. Drag-and-drop or paste images.

## Additional Notes

Anything reviewers should pay extra attention to: schema migrations, env
var changes, performance impact, security considerations.
